root_cause.text: The `dw_i3c_master_i2c_xfers()` function in the DesignWare I3C master driver fails to release the allocated `xfer` memory structure when `pm_runtime_resume_and_get()` returns an error.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds a call to `dw_i3c_master_free_xfer(xfer)` inside the error handling block for `pm_runtime_resume_and_get()` in `drivers/i3c/master/dw-i3c-master.c` to prevent a memory leak before returning.
